component: UART-03 UHCI0 and shared FIFO audit

physical_rx_event_contract.uart_callback: void callback(void *opaque, unsigned index, bool is_break, bool delimiter_queued, unsigned queued_bytes)
physical_rx_event_contract.source: Parent UART samples the physical all-low frame detector once after the final stop sample and after optional FIFO insertion; delimiter_queued is true only for an actually inserted NULL frame. Idle callbacks sample the physical FIFO count; independent console input never emits these events.
physical_rx_event_contract.processing: Store absolute raw-byte boundary snapshots in a fixed513-entry ring (largest target RX FIFO512 bytes plus empty boundary). Coalesce duplicate boundaries. Process only bytes before the boundary, discard one actual queued NULL only when the real UART explicitly qualifies it, then close EOF. Later bytes remain in the real FIFO for the next packet; multiple pre-BH events remain distinct.
physical_rx_event_contract.zero_payload: Ordinary zero-valued payload is preserved. Masked/overflowed break frames carry delimiter_queued=false; no NULL is fabricated or blindly removed.
physical_rx_event_contract.semantic_reference: TRM v1.8 register26.34 p967 UART_RX_BRK_EOF_EN ends payload receive when a NULL frame is received; UART_ERR_WR_MASK's pinned uart_reg.h description defines whether errored UART frames actually enter FIFO.
physical_rx_event_contract.qualification: The explicit all-low/actually-queued metadata and delimiter exclusion are the adopted machine/fixture contract. The inspected TRM describes the NULL-triggered EOF but does not explicitly enumerate whether the terminating NULL appears in GDMA payload; silicon boundary qualification remains required before claiming that undocumented detail hardware-verified.
native_vectors: queued break NULL excluded while later packet preserved
masked break preserves ordinary zero payload and later zero byte
forty distinct idle events before service plus duplicate event coalescing

specification_blockers: TRM and pinned headers do not define formatting header byte layout, header sequence/ack/checksum state and target CRC initial value/byte order; HEAD_EN/CRC modes suspend with LOG_UNIMP instead of fabricated bytes.
Quick-send NUM mode packet mapping/length is unspecified by inspected primary target sources; quick-send enabled modes suspend with LOG_UNIMP.
Hung-conf timeout tick unit and shift interpretation are unspecified; hung IRQ timing is not implemented and cannot be claimed complete.

Shared FIFO SIZE=0 encoding is unspecified despite TRM saying UART0 TX supports eight blocks and register field being three bits; do not infer zero means eight or disabled without silicon/primary documentation.

shared_fifo_audit.conclusion: All six FIFOs alias one physical RAM. Fixed start addresses do not move on expansion. UART0 TX_SIZE=2 occupies UART1 default TX block and UART1 transmitting cannot be used (explicit TRM example). Six privately allocated expanding FIFOs would be incorrect.
shared_fifo_audit.provider: Parent-owned ESP32S3UARTMemory QOM object bytes[1024], fifo-memory links on all three UARTs, independent per-FIFO cursors over shared backing windows; overlap behavior beyond TRM unusable warning is not specified.
